jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Platform (Orchestration & AI)
jobs.description:
Introduction to Demandbase:

Demandbase is the only pipeline AI platform that empowers GTM teams to automate growth at scale. With a unified view of data, insights, actions, and outcomes, B2B enterprises can seamlessly align and execute their account-based GTM strategies with confidence. Thousands of businesses trust Demandbase to maximize revenue, minimize waste, and consolidate their data and tech stacks – all in one platform. 

As a company, we’re as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class technology. We invest heavily in people, our culture, and the community around us. We have also continuously been recognized as One of The Best Places To Work in the San Francisco Bay Area by Fortune, and One of The 60 Best Companies To Sell For by Selling Power. Our offices are located in San Francisco, New York, Austin, Seattle, India, and the United Kingdom. 


THE ROLE

With the rise of LLMs, and the prevalence of ML-models to find patterns in customer data, we’re noticing the B2B SaaS space move from being able to generate meaningful insights based on data to being able to execute meaningful actions against the insights generated.

At Demandbase, we believe our Orchestration Engine (the system that allows B2B teams to automate their Go-To-Market strategy at scale) is core to our value proposition. As the Lead Product Manager for Orchestration, you will be the primary architect of this "Action Layer."

You will lead a high-impact team focused on building the logic, triggers, and workflows that connect our rich account intelligence to real-world execution. Your challenge is twofold: maintaining a world-class, high-scale orchestration platform while strategically infusing Demandbase AI to move toward more intelligent, agentic use cases.




STRATEGIC RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Drive the Orchestration Roadmap: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of our workflow builder, trigger logic, and action framework. You will ensure our orchestration engine is the most flexible, reliable, and user-friendly tool in the B2B market.

 - Deepen the Integration Fabric: Drive the strategy for how our engine interacts with the broader tech stack (Salesforce, Marketo, Slack, etc.). You’ll ensure that complex, multi-step "Plays" execute seamlessly across distributed third-party ecosystems.

 - Pragmatic AI Integration: Instead of "AI for AI's sake," you will identify specific orchestration friction points—such as manual segment building or rigid workflow rules—and solve them using Demandbase AI.

 - Bridge to Agentic Use Cases: Lay the groundwork for autonomous GTM. You will define how our orchestration logic can support emerging Model Context Protocol (MCP) standards, allowing AI agents to "understand" and "trigger" existing workflows safely.

 - Scale & Performance: Partner with Principal Engineering to ensure the orchestration layer can handle massive event volumes (billions of signals) with the low latency required for real-time sales and marketing alerts.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING (ORCHESTRATION EXPERT PROFILE)

 - 7+ Years in Product Management: With at least 3-4 years specifically focused on Orchestration, Workflow Automation, or Integration Platforms (e.g., experience with Zapier, Tray.io http://Tray.io, Marketo, or CRM automation).

 - Logical Architect Mindset: You have a deep love for "If-This-Then-That" logic, Boolean filters, and complex state machines. You understand the nuances of race conditions, retries, and error handling in automated systems.

 - Technical Fluency: You are comfortable discussing API design, webhooks, and distributed event processing with Principal Engineers. You understand how data flows through a modern enterprise stack.

 - Applied AI Knowledge: You understand the fundamentals of LLMs and Agentic frameworks, but you approach them through the lens of a systems builder—prioritizing reliability and "human-in-the-loop" controls over hype.

 - B2B Domain Authority: You understand how a Sales Ops or Marketing Ops leader thinks. You know that for them, "automation" is only as good as its transparency and predictability.




KEY SUCCESS METRICS

 1. Orchestration Depth: Increasing the complexity and volume of automated "Plays" running across our customer base.

 2. Platform Extensibility: Reducing the effort required to add new third-party actions to the orchestration library.

 3. AI-Assisted Efficiency: Measuring time-savings for users by using AI to suggest, build, or optimize orchestration logic.




WHY THIS ROLE?

This is the ultimate role for an autonomous, high agency PM who loves systems thinking, and is equally comfortable thinking strategically as well as can sweat the details. You aren't just building a feature; you are building the "Central Nervous System" of the GTM stack. You will have the unique opportunity to take a proven, market-leading orchestration engine and guide its transition into the AI-powered future.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Demandbase

At Demandbase, we believe in creating a workplace culture that values and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We recognize that everyone brings unique experiences, perspectives, and identities to the table, and we are committed to building a community where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported. Discrimination of any kind is not tolerated, and we strive to ensure that every individual has an equal opportunity to succeed and grow, regardless of their gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, race, ethnicity, background, marital status, genetic information, education level, veteran status, national origin, or any other protected status. We do not automatically disqualify applicants with criminal records and will consider each applicant on a case-by-case basis.

We recognize that not all candidates will have every skill or qualification listed in this job description. If you feel you have the level of experience to be successful in the role, we encourage you to apply!

We acknowledge that true diversity and inclusion requires ongoing effort, and we are committed to doing the work required to make our workplace a safe and equitable space for all. Join us in building a community where we can learn from each other, celebrate our differences, and work together.

Unsolicited Submissions

At Demandbase, we value thoughtful partnerships and direct connections with candidates. We’re not accepting unsolicited resumes or outreach from third-party recruiting agencies. Any unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed, and no fees will be paid.

THE ROLE

Demandbase is accelerating its Agentic Marketing roadmap to bring customers an AI-native platform that performs critical B2B marketing jobs on behalf of marketers. We are looking for a senior product manager to ensure those capabilities do not merely ship; they become trusted, habitual, and monetizable parts of how marketing teams work.

This role will own the customer journey from initial discovery and first value through repeat AI usage, cross-capability adoption, consumption growth, and commercial expansion.




STRATEGIC RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define the product-led growth strategy for Demandbase’s AI-native application

 - Own the end-to-end adoption funnel across discovery, activation, repeat use, capability composition, AI consumption, and expansion

 - Identify the behaviors that represent meaningful customer value, not merely clicks, sessions, or feature exposure

 - Partner with application PMs to remove friction and introduce the next relevant job or capability at the right moment

 - Design and run product experiments involving onboarding, recommendations, defaults, templates, notifications, approvals, usage visibility, and upgrade paths

 - Develop lifecycle strategies for new customers and existing customers across multiple GTM user personas

 - Partner with Product Analytics and Data Science to establish instrumentation, behavioral cohorts, experimentation methods, and leading indicators of retention and expansion

 - Partner with Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing on AI packaging, credit models, trials, entitlements, and expansion motions

 - Create reusable growth patterns and platform requirements that can be applied across composable capabilities

 - Turn successful experiments into durable product experiences and operating practices


WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - 5+ Years in Product Management or related field with experience in SaaS growth, PLG, AI products, or workflow platforms

 - Demonstrated ability to move activation, retention, expansion, or consumption metrics through shipped product changes

 - Comfortable working across onboarding, core workflows, lifecycle engagement, packaging, and monetization

 - Strong analytical and experimental judgment; able to distinguish correlation from evidence sufficient for a product decision

 - Experience influencing multiple product teams without taking over their roadmaps

 - Able to connect customer behavior, qualitative research, product strategy, and commercial outcomes

 - Familiarity with enterprise buying and adoption dynamics; understand that enterprise PLG includes admins, champions, permissions, enablement, and sales-assisted expansion

 - AI product experience is strongly preferred


KEY SUCCESS METRICS

 - Establish a shared AI adoption and monetization funnel

 - Define activation for each priority JTBD and for the composed product experience

 - Reduce time to first meaningful AI outcome

 - Increase the percentage of active users and tenants completing high-value AI jobs

 - Increase repeat AI use and the number of customers using multiple complementary capabilities

 - Identify which behaviors predict retention, expansion, and increased AI consumption

 - Launch and evaluate experiments that materially improve adoption

 - Help define the product mechanics required for trials, entitlements, credit visibility, and usage-based expansion




WHY THIS ROLE?

This is the ideal role for a high-agency, analytically minded PM who loves turning customer behavior into product decisions and experiments. You won’t just ship AI features; you’ll ensure customers discover them, reach value quickly, build habits around them, and expand into the broader composable platform. You will have the unique opportunity to build the growth engine that turns Demandbase’s AI-native vision into sustained adoption, consumption, retention, and revenue.
